propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate presented monthly pricing recommendations at the commercial review and kept the action log; in September 2023 the commercial director adopted two of the three recommendations and deferred the third.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the presentations, the work sample contains the September 2023 pack and minutes, and the reference confirms the role at the review.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate evaluated the 2023 weekend minimum-stay test against six matched control hotels using difference-in-differences.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry describes the test design directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the daily extract from the property management system with row-count and late-arrival checks.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry describes the pipeline and its checks.

expectedGap: A written dashboard guide is described, but no training sessions for revenue managers are documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the commercial review record, including the deferred recommendation, as supported evidence; do not attribute revenue outcomes to the adopted recommendations.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate trained revenue managers on the pricing dashboard beyond the written guide, and how many sessions were run.
